name: Cherry Hill Mini June 2026

venue.name: American Legion Post 372
venue.address: 1532 Martin Ave, Cherry Hill Township, NJ 08002

information:
This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the WCA regulations. If you are new to competing, please refer to the Competition Procedures tab.

**This competition takes place on a Thursday Night 6PM-10PM, this is not a standard weekend competition. **
